title: Return History and Marlowe Rewards Earning: Training Questions on the Low-Return Accelerator
content:
**What is the low-return accelerator?**
When Marlowe Rewards points are credited on a reservation fulfilment order that never earned them, a member who has had few refunds under Returns & Exchanges earns at a higher multiplier. The accelerator is added to the multiplier the qualifying spend is multiplied by, before the product is rounded to a whole point.

**Which refunds count?**
The refunds issued on the member's returns: the refund-issued entries in the returns' settlement history, by their date.

**What are the steps?**

| Refunds issued in the 6 months ending on the handling date | Refunds issued in the 12 months ending on the handling date | Accelerator |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 0.15 |
| none | at least one | 0.05 |
| at least one | at least one | none |

**Illustrations (hypothetical handling date of 1 October 2025).**

- The member's last refund was issued on 15 June 2024. There is none in the 12 months, so the accelerator is 0.15.
- The member's last refund was issued on 10 January 2025. There is none in the 6 months but one in the 12 months, so the accelerator is 0.05.
- A refund was issued on 12 August 2025, so there is no accelerator.
